programs.desc: Piggy reluctantly helps Howie and Octo finally win a role-playing game of Dirks and Dragons. Then, Batty invokes the Penguin Clause and tries to take over the hotel.

programs.desc: Howie does everyone's jobs - to help him decide who should be Employee of the Month. Then, Howie and the staff collect saliva for Octo, whose tongue has dried up.

programs.title: Total Drama Ridonculous Race
programs.desc: Teams learn and perform a traditional Maori dance and someone makes a truly permanent mistake.

programs.title: Total Drama Ridonculous Race

programs.title: Total Drama Ridonculous Race

programs.title: Total Drama Ridonculous Race
programs.desc: What happens in Vegas stays in Vegas! Unless of course everything that happens in Vegas ends up on TV, like this...

programs.desc: It's a wild Mexican adventure with hot peppers, high cliff dives, and heavy burros.

programs.title: Total Drama Ridonculous Race
programs.desc: When our six remaining teams are forced to become two super-teams the Axis of Evil is created. Have mercy on us all!

programs.title: Total Drama Ridonculous Race
